title: [P0-P2][NO_GO] PoN security, native consensus, Cell Swarm and Hepta evolution acceptance ledger
body:
# P0–P2 blocker ledger: Chain as Hepta's distributed, fail-closed model-commons settlement layer

**Freeze time:** 2026-10-30 (US); GitHub observation 2026-10-31 UTC. This is a tracking issue, NOT an independent acceptance or activation receipt.

**Exact observed baselines**:
- Chain `main`: `dd6e1c3cbeacbdc532b0679297835b3a0aac78f0`.
- Hepta `main`: `732e934ba496d90fbe042b8d41d479ef901643e5`.
- Native chain integration [#557](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/557): observed HEAD `cf84391a474ee1f3ac78f4a907bd95184b816a54` (independent Draft, later updates require refetch).
- Original W1/cost [#545](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/545): `ead1000360d24247f3c6159d50b2c8663ff4af4f`.
- Quantum mining research [#550](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/550): `162000f1d81631ac257e1eccf3f31cd976d6d977`.
- PQ PCP2 Cell provider [#590](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/590): `8141887759527ccb9d033a88aa89fa59310101ec`.
- Cell Swarm [#595](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/595): first opt-in bounded local byte assembler; **not live network/DA or PQ acceptance**.

## Workstream closure requirements (all remain OPEN)

- [ ] **P0 source/authority freeze**: recursively enumerate exact reachable crypto, work, authorization, storage, protocol/wire domain and release branches; attach HEAD/base/tree, blob/provenance maps, unchanged raw positive/negative logs, and an independent source-to-binary audit. Historical snapshot is not latest automatically.
- [ ] **P0 W1 cheapest LEGAL valid solver and invalid admission**: frozen original candidate/work profile; zero/low rank, sparse/structured, precomputation, many challenges, batch CPU/GPU/ASIC, finite quantum model; fastest *verified* valid ticket cost vs invalid rejection incl. full resources. Report honest and adversarial winning denominators, no 'hardness lower bound' from sampled implementations. Preserve cheap-ticket-forgery amplification.
- [ ] **P0 native consensus/reorg**: M02/M07/M08 single owner, absolute work/confirmation/phase deadlines propagated through synchronous IPC, branch-aware replay/undo, deep reorg, original effects journal, actual stop/power-loss tests, isolated hostile WAN miners. [#557](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/pull/557) retains cold History and finite honest-client failures; a prior IPC waited up to 180 s independent of the original 30 s phase. Do not mask this by merely raising deadlines.
- [ ] **P0 full-chain PQ**: six independent A–F criteria from [#562](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/issues/562) all closed on the ordinary reachable caller graph, not on opt-in components. Include signature-size/TPS, downgrade migration, W1/PQ128, quantum DAA, original-budget hostile load and externally witnessed antirollback.
- [ ] **P1 Cell Swarm**: content-addressed immutable manifest under independent Hepta owner pin; real signed PQ provider discovery, bounded request/byte/CPU/connection, concurrent multi-source transfer, 3+ independent failure domains, repair/rare-version availability, custody/retrieval evidence, p95/p99 and offline/author-loss recovery. #595 is **only byte-integrity groundwork** and cannot grant FinalUse.
- [ ] **P1 actual Hepta learning loop**: ordinary authorized task -> real parent training -> independently admitted evaluation -> public consent -> Cell fetch from other owners -> ordinary install and prospective new task, repeated for 3 *genuinely improving* generations or retained no-gain evidence. No fixture receipt may manufacture owner/withdrawal/export authority.
- [ ] **P1 full end-to-end throughput**: distinct prepared/executed/included/confirmed counts, exact block size and W1 work difficulty, 1/2/4/8+ workers, CPU/RSS/GPU/VRAM, WAL, cold restart, p95/p99, Cell load. Do NOT reuse ~25.6 TPS nominal devnet ceiling as measured throughput.
- [ ] **P2 BTC-NG/Prism/DAG controlled comparison**: identical node hardware, WAN delay/loss/Byzantine budget, ingress and data availability, transaction mix, security risk, state roots and observed confirmation. Keep alternative consensus in isolated research without unreviewed fork-choice activation.

## Fail-closed rules
- Current `config/consensus-mainline.json`: runtime, work qualification, public readiness and production activation remain false.
- Whole-chain PQ128/public/production = **NO_GO**, #562 gates A–F open.
- A focused component PASS cannot close whole-system admission, future-window efficacy, independent operators, full source/merge CI or unknown evidence.
- Source-independent custody and permission are different facts; downloaded bytes != admission authority.
- No force push, protected-main overwrite, old BFT/hash fallback, hidden activation, fabricated benchmarks, or replacing known-red original tests.

**Next dependency sequence**: stabilize exact-head source and running P0 gates before deciding whether P1/P2 results justify protocol changes. Keep independent PRs isolated and reconcile only after exact new merged-source requalification.
